description: **Amazon Bedrock** now actually works. The previous `bedrock-runtime` OpenAI-compatible endpoint always returned HTTP 200 with an AWS-internal routing error regardless of credential/model/region, which the retry logic silently retried for ~6 minutes with no visible error. Switched to Bedrock's `bedrock-mantle` Anthropic-compatible endpoint and corrected the curated model ids; requires a long-term Bedrock API key (short-term/session keys are rejected by `bedrock-mantle`) and model access granted per-model in the Bedrock console.

**Claude Pro/Max subscription models now appear in `/model`.** After a successful `claude login`, Atlas previously seeded nothing into the picker for the Claude Agent SDK harness backend, so `/model` stayed empty with no indication of what to do next.
**`/model` now shows a provider suffix** (e.g. `5.6 Sol · Codex`, `Sonnet 4.6 · Amazon Bedrock`) so the same model reachable through different connections stays distinguishable.
**`atlas login bedrock`** now accepts a comma-separated list of model ids, matching OpenRouter's setup flow, instead of a single model.
